mapper.select: SELECT course.id AS course_id, course.title AS course_title, course.subject, course.grade_level, COUNT(DISTINCT chapter.id) AS total_chapters, SUM(CASE WHEN progress.progress_percent = 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_chapters, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT chapter.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(SUM(COALESCE(progress.progress_percent, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT chapter.id)) END AS progress_percent, enrollment.enrolled_time, MAX(progress.updated_time) AS last_learning_time FROM learning_course_enrollment enrollment INNER JOIN learning_course course ON course.id = enrollment.course_id AND course.deleted = 0 AND course.status = 1 LEFT JOIN learning_course_chapter chapter ON chapter.course_id = course.id AND chapter.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN learning_chapter_progress progress ON progress.enrollment_id = enrollment.id AND progress.chapter_id = chapter.id WHERE enrollment.user_id = #{userId} AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY course.id, course.title, course.subject, course.grade_level, enrollment.enrolled_time ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(progress.updated_time), enrollment.enrolled_time) DESC, course.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
